paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm akum lina ah hiai thu TOUPA kiang a kipan Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi:
heading: Tempul Ah Baruk In Laibuzial Asim
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Laibuzial la inla, hiai ah na kiang a thu ka gen tengteng, Israel tungthu, Judah tungthu, nam tengteng tungthu, na kiang a thu ka gen ni a kipan, Josiah hun lai a kipan, tuni tanpha a thu gelh in.
english: “Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.

paite: Judah inkote'n atung ua thil hoih lou hih ka tup tengteng, angaikhia un michih in a-omdan gilou uh ahei thei khamoh kei ding uh, athulimlouhna uh leh akhelhna uh ka ngaihdam theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Neriah tapa Baruk asam a, huchi in Baruk in TOUPA thu tengteng, akiang a agensa Jeremiah paukam a kipan laibuzial ah agelh hi.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all Yahweh’s words, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Baruk kiang ah, "Khakkhum ka hi a, TOUPA' inn ah ka hoh thei kei,
english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into Yahweh’s house.

paite: huaiziak in nang hoh inla, TOUPA thu ka paukam a kipan laibuzial a na gelh an ngawl ni in, TOUPA' inn a mipite bil a zak in va simkhia in; akhopi ua kipan a hong pawt Judahte tengteng bil a zak in leng na simkhiak ding ahi.
english: Therefore you go, and read from the scroll which you have written from my mouth, Yahweh’s words, in the ears of the people in Yahweh’s house on the fast day. Also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

paite: Michih in a-omdan gilou uh hei in, TOUPA ma a hehpihna angetna uh, atun thei kha zenzen ding uam, hiai mite tung a hehna leh thangpaihna TOUPA'N agenkhiak lah athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.
english: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahweh, and will each return from his evil way; for Yahweh has pronounced great anger and wrath against this people.”

paite: Huchi in Neriah tapa Baruk in zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak tengteng bang in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA thu laibu a om asimta hi.
english: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book Yahweh’s words in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm akum ngana, akha kuana ah Jerusalem mi tengteng leh Judah khopi a kipan a Jerusalem a hong pai tengteng in an ngawl thu apuangta uhi.
english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.

paite: Huan Baruk in TOUPA kongpi thak lutna ah, um sung tungnungzaw a laigelhmi Shaphan tapa Gemariah dantan, TOUPA' inn a om ah Jeremiah thu laibu a om, mi tengteng bil azak in asim hi.
english: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.

paite: Huan Shaphan tapa Gemariah tapa Mikaiah in laibu a om TOUPA thu tengteng ana zak in,
heading: Laibuzial Nasemte Kiang A Simna
english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,

paite: Kumpipa' inn ah ahohsuk a, laigelhmi dantan ah alut a, huan, ngai dih, huai ah heutu tengteng ana tu ua, laigelhmi Elishamate, Shemaiah tapa Delaiah, Akbor tapa Elnathan, Shaphan tapa Gemariah, Hananiah tapa Zedekiah leh heutu tengteng.
english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

paite: Huan Mikaiah in mite bil a zak in Baruk in laibu asim thu ana zak tengteng ahilh hi.
english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

paite: Huan heutu tengteng in Kushi tapa, Shelemiah tapa Nethaniah tapa Jehudi Baruk kiang ah asawl ua, akiang ah, "Mite bil a zak a na sim laibu tawi in hong pai in," chi ding in. Huchi in Neriah tapa Baruk bel laibuzial tawi in akiang uah ahong hi.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.

paite: Akiang ah, "Tu inla, ka bil ua ka zak ngei un sim dih ve leh," achi ua, huchi in Baruk in abil ua azak un asimta hi.
english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thute azak uleh lau in aki-entuah chiat ua, Baruk kiang ah, "Hiai thu tengteng kumpipa ka hilh ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”

paite: Baruk kiang ah, "Hiai thu tengteng na kam a kipan bangchidan a gelh na hia, hon hilh in?" chi in adong uhi.
english: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”

paite: Baruk in, "Hiai thu tengteng apaukam in ahon hilh a, laitui in laibu ah ka gelh mai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”

paite: Heutute'n Baruk kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Jeremiah toh kibu un; kuamah in na omna uh thei kei hen," achi uhi.
english: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”

paite: Huchi in huangsung ah kumpipa kiang ah alut ua; laibuzial bel laigelhmi Elishama dantan ah akoih ua; athu tengteng paukam in kumpipa ahilh uh.
heading: Kumpipa Jehoiakim In Laibuzial Ahalna
english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n laibuzial la ding in Jehudi asawl a, laigelhmi Elishama dantan a kipan ala uhi. Huan Jehudi in kumpipa leh kumpipa kiang a dingh heutu tengteng bil a zak in asim hi.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

paite: Akha kuana ahi a, kumpipa bel aphalbi inn ah atu a, ama a meihol thuk ah kuang a-om hi.
english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jehudi in khep thum hiam khep li hiam a sim in kumpipa in atemta in alaibuzial a-attan a, meikhuk ah pum katmang vek ding in alawnlut zel hi.
english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

paite: Kumpipa leh anasem mite'n hiai thu tengteng ngaikhe mite kuamah alau kei ua, apuansilh uh leng abotkek sam kei uh.
english: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.

paite: Huai phet hilou in Elnathan leh Delaiah leh Gemariahte'n laibuzial hal lou ding in kumpipa kiang ah angen ua, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei.
english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n kumpipa tapa Jerahmeel leh Azriel tapa Seraiah leh Abdeel tapa Shelemiah Baruk laigelhmi leh zawlnei Jeremiah man ding in thu apia a; himahleh TOUPA'N amau asel hi.
english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.

paite: Huan laibuzial leh Jeremiah kam a kipan Baruk in agelh tengteng thute kumpipa'n ahalmang khit in TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
heading: Jeremiah In Laibuzial Dang Agelh
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Laibuzial dang la inla, laibuzial masa a thu tengteng, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim in ahal mangsate gelh nawn vek in.
english: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tungtang thu ah huchi in na gen ding hi. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Babilon kumpipa hong pai a, hiai gam hihsia in, hiai mi leh sa ahihmang vek ding chih, bangziak a huchibang thu gelh na hia? chi in laibuzial na halta hi.
english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘Yahweh says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written therein, saying, “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cause to cease from there man and animal”?’”

paite: Huaiziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tungthu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: David tutphah a tu ding mi anei kei ding; aluang leng sun nisa ah leh zan vuk nuai ah paihkhiak ahi ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

paite: Athulimlouhna uh ziak in amah leh asuante leh anasem mite ka gawt ding; amau leh Jerusalem a tengte leh Judah mite tung ah atung ua ka phuansa, angaihkhiak kei uleh thil hoih lou tengteng ka hon tun ding," chi in.
english: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.”’”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in laibuzial dang ala a, Neriah tapa Baruk laigelhmi apia a, ama'n huai ah Jeremiah kam a kipan laibu gelhsa tengteng, Jehoiakim in mei a akhulmangsa thute agelh a; huai ban ah akibatpih thu tampi abehlap lai hi.
english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.
